name: MTMIS Punjab Vehicle Verification Online
author: fazalniazi

sections.description:
Want to verify a vehicle in Punjab, Pakistan without visiting the Excise office? This plugin is your answer. Visit TrafficSignsTest.com — Pakistan’s most trusted driving license preparation platform — for traffic signs practice tests, driving license fee calculators, e-challan checkers, and complete DLIMS guides.

Niazi Vehicle Verification for Pakistan is a free, lightweight WordPress plugin that gives your website visitors a single-click shortcut to the official MTMIS Punjab (Motor Transport Management Information System) vehicle verification portal — managed by the Excise and Taxation Department Punjab. With simple shortcodes and clean buttons, your visitors can instantly verify any Punjab-registered vehicle, check token tax status, confirm ownership by CNIC, and track smart card delivery — all without leaving your website environment.

This plugin is an independent, non-official tool. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Government of Punjab, Excise and Taxation Department, or PITB. It is designed purely as a helper to guide WordPress website visitors to the correct official government portal.

What is MTMIS Punjab?

MTMIS stands for Motor Transport Management Information System. It is an official online platform developed by the Excise and Taxation Department Punjab in collaboration with the Punjab Information Technology Board (PITB). Launched in 2003, MTMIS has completely transformed how citizens interact with vehicle registration services in Punjab, Pakistan.

Before MTMIS, verifying a vehicle required a full-day visit to the Excise office. Today, anyone can verify a Punjab-registered vehicle in under 30 seconds from their phone — completely free. The system stores complete records for millions of vehicles including cars, motorcycles, buses, trucks, tractors, and commercial vehicles registered across all districts of Punjab including Lahore, Faisalabad, Rawalpindi, Multan, Gujranwala, and more.

MTMIS Punjab allows citizens to access:

  • Vehicle Verification by Registration Number — Check ownership, engine number, chassis number, and registration details
  • Vehicle Verification by CNIC — See all vehicles registered under a specific National Identity Card number
  • Token Tax Status — Check whether token tax is paid or pending, with real-time dues calculation
  • Smart Card Status Tracking — Track the delivery status of your vehicle registration smart card
  • Application Tracking — Check the status of your ownership transfer or new registration application
  • e-Registration Card — Access digital vehicle registration information

As of 2026, MTMIS Punjab has been upgraded with real-time challan synchronization, biometric ownership transfer, and mobile app support through the Excise Punjab platform.

Why Use This Plugin?

Millions of people in Punjab need to verify vehicles every month. Whether someone is buying a used car, confirming their motorcycle registration, checking if token tax is paid, or tracking a smart card — these are among the most searched topics on Pakistani driving and vehicle websites.

By adding this plugin to your WordPress site, you give your visitors a one-click solution to reach the official MTMIS Punjab portal instantly. No confusion, no searching — just clearly labeled buttons that take them directly to the right official page.

  • No coding required — Add shortcodes to any page or post in seconds
  • Mobile-friendly — Works perfectly on phones, tablets, and desktops
  • Lightweight — Zero impact on your website loading speed
  • Free forever — No premium version, no upsells, no hidden charges
  • Direct links — Points to official government MTMIS portal only

Plugin Features

1. Vehicle Verification Button
Adds a button that takes visitors directly to the official MTMIS Punjab vehicle verification page at mtmis.excise.punjab.gov.pk. Users can enter their vehicle registration number (e.g., LXX-1234) or CNIC to instantly check ownership, engine number, chassis number, registration status, and token tax information.

2. CNIC Vehicle Check Button
Adds a dedicated button for CNIC-based verification — allowing users to see all vehicles registered under their National Identity Card number. This is especially useful for confirming whether an unknown vehicle is linked to your CNIC, or for buyers confirming seller ownership.

3. Smart Card Status Tracker Button
Adds a button linking to the official MTMIS smart card tracking portal. Users who have applied for a new vehicle registration, ownership transfer, or duplicate smart card can check whether their card is under processing, ready for dispatch, or already delivered.

4. Token Tax Check Button
Adds a button for checking vehicle token tax status. Pending dues are shown in real-time through the official Excise Punjab system. Users can confirm whether annual token tax has been paid and check the amount due.

5. All-in-One Button Set
Use a single shortcode to display all MTMIS service buttons together in a clean layout — perfect for dedicated vehicle verification help pages.

6. Widget Support
Add any of the MTMIS buttons to your sidebar, footer, or any widget area using the built-in WordPress widget.

7. Fully Customizable
Control button text and which services to show using simple shortcode parameters.

How to Use

Show all MTMIS buttons:
[niazi_vehicle_verify]

Show only Vehicle Verification button:
[niazi_vehicle_verify show=”verify”]

Show only CNIC Check button:
[niazi_vehicle_verify show=”cnic”]

Show only Smart Card Tracker button:
[niazi_vehicle_verify show=”smartcard”]

Show only Token Tax Check button:
[niazi_vehicle_verify show=”tokentax”]

Custom button labels:
[niazi_vehicle_verify verify_text=”Verify My Vehicle” cnic_text=”CNIC Vehicle Check” smartcard_text=”Track Smart Card”]

About MTMIS Punjab Services

Vehicle Verification:
Vehicle verification is the most used MTMIS feature in Punjab. Buyers and sellers use it to confirm registration details before any transaction. Employers use it to verify company vehicle records. Law enforcement uses it to track stolen vehicles. Anyone can verify a Punjab-registered car, bike, or commercial vehicle by entering the registration number on the official MTMIS portal. The system instantly displays ownership name, engine number, chassis number, registration date, token tax status, and any pending challans.

CNIC-Based Vehicle Check:
This powerful feature allows users to check all vehicles currently registered under a specific CNIC number. This helps buyers confirm that the seller is the genuine registered owner of the vehicle. It also helps vehicle owners confirm whether any unauthorized vehicle has been registered under their CNIC without their knowledge. The process requires entering your 13-digit CNIC number (without dashes) and completing a simple CAPTCHA.

Smart Card Status Tracking:
Punjab Excise has replaced the old paper registration book with a modern Smart Card — a wallet-sized, chip-based vehicle registration document containing all vehicle details. It includes security printing, an embedded chip, QR code, holographic stickers, and a unique tracking ID. After applying for a new vehicle registration or ownership transfer, citizens can track their smart card status online using the MTMIS portal — checking whether it is under processing, dispatched, or delivered.

Token Tax Check:
Token tax is an annual tax paid by all vehicle owners in Punjab. As of 2026, MTMIS Punjab shows token tax dues in real-time with automatic late fee calculations. Vehicle owners can check their pending token tax directly through the MTMIS portal using their registration number.

Step-by-Step Guide: How to Verify a Vehicle on MTMIS Punjab

  1. Open the MTMIS portal — Visit mtmis.excise.punjab.gov.pk (use the button added by this plugin)
  2. Choose verification method — By Registration Number or by CNIC
  3. Enter Registration Number — Format example: LXX-1234 or LEA-5678 (include the dash)
  4. Complete CAPTCHA — Enter the security code shown on screen
  5. Click Search/Verify — The system retrieves the vehicle record from the Excise database
  6. View results — Ownership name, engine number, chassis number, registration status, token tax, and any pending challans are displayed instantly

Tips for accurate results:
* Always use the correct registration number format with the district code
* Double-check your CNIC number (13 digits, no dashes) for CNIC-based checks
* If a vehicle is not found, it may not be Punjab-registered — try Sindh or KPK portals instead
* Older vehicles may have incomplete records — visit the Excise office to update

Frequently Asked Questions

What is MTMIS Punjab?

MTMIS stands for Motor Transport Management Information System — the official Punjab government online portal for vehicle verification, token tax, smart card tracking, and ownership records, managed by the Excise and Taxation Department Punjab.

How can I verify a vehicle in Punjab online?

Use the Vehicle Verification button added by this plugin to go directly to the official MTMIS Punjab portal. Enter the registration number or CNIC to check vehicle details instantly.

Can I check how many vehicles are registered on my CNIC?

Yes. Use the CNIC Vehicle Check button to see all vehicles currently registered under your National Identity Card number.

What is a Smart Card and how do I track it?

A Smart Card is the official digital vehicle registration document issued by Excise Punjab. Use the Smart Card Tracker button in this plugin to check your card’s delivery status online.

Is token tax information available online?

Yes. The MTMIS portal shows real-time token tax status and pending dues for all Punjab-registered vehicles.

Does MTMIS work for all provinces?

No. MTMIS Punjab only covers vehicles registered in Punjab. For Sindh or KPK registered vehicles, separate provincial portals exist.

Is this plugin official?

No. This is an independent WordPress plugin providing shortcut buttons to the official MTMIS Punjab government portal. It is not affiliated with the Government of Punjab, Excise Department, or PITB.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, completely free with no hidden charges or premium upgrades.

Visit TrafficSignsTest.com for free traffic signs practice tests, Pakistan driving license fee calculator, e-challan checker, DLIMS guides, and complete driving license preparation resources.

  • E-Challan checker for Punjab (PSCA)
  • DLIMS Punjab driving license guides
  • Complete guides for MTMIS vehicle verification
sections.installation:
1. Upload the niazi-vehicle-verification-pakistan folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Add shortcode [niazi_vehicle_verify] to any page or post
  4. Or go to Appearance → Widgets and add the Vehicle Verification widget to your sidebar
